_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a global biopharmaceutical company, consisting of global pharmaceutical/biotechnology and international consumer medicines businesses, whose mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious disease' (FY2009 10-K, Item 7); 'We face intense competition from other pharmaceutical manufacturers, including both innovative medicines and lower-priced generic products.' (Item 1A heading); 'We depend on key products for most of our net sales, cash flows and earnings.' (Item 1A heading); 'It is possible that we may lose market exclusivity of a product earlier than expected.' (Item 1A heading)

BEAR.desc: EPS -65.2%/yr (worst year FY02-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +3.5%/yr (Q4 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.1-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +6.8%/yr (FY02-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +83.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2011-02-04) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.51x (88.3% downside to Bear $3 / +172.4% upside to Bull $70) | Adj composite 2.84 vs market 1.54: gap +1.30 [UNDERVALUED] | -22% above the EPP floor $33 (16x FY11E $2.05) | Conservative 2-yr case: +82.8% total (+41.4%/yr) | At 12.5x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $34 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues +5.4% in Q4 2010, forward revenues +2% (no FY11 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2010 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
